info.description: Standard OpenAI-compatible `POST /v1/images/generations` endpoint. As of September 30, 2026 it serves `seedream-5-0-260128`, `wan2.7-image`, `wan2.7-image-pro`, `gpt-image-2`, `gpt-image-2.5-flare`, and `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`. No image model is served on `/v1/chat/completions`; Gemini-compatible `generateContent` requests use [`/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent`](/api-reference/chat/post_models-model-generatecontent).
info.title: OpenAI-Compatible Image Generations
